node.description: Id of exactly one development {node} (`<{group}>/<{node}>`); {group} ids are rejected

owner.description: The owner (user) of the diagram groups; default: inventory.owner of the {node}

diagramGroups.description: The diagram groups to tag; never empty or blank (StartCLI would tag everything of the owner)

tag.description: The new tag, e.g. REL-2026-10-07; a tag that exists for the owner is refused (never moved)

confirmationCode.description: The code from the preview of the first call; sets the tag
